limitations: One ordered 256/512/256 comparison; not randomized or sustained qualification.
The same binary pair uses map v2 capacity512 in every condition. Default installed map v1 is unchanged.
CPU windows use graph-ready stdout observation and interpolation; exact audio windows use capture frames.
Counter deltas span the whole capture and control responses, not just the held chord. Completed frames count successful processing responses, not timely delivery.
Process CPU sums surviving threads in the owned cohort. Short-lived threads may be absent; whole-cohort CPU is reported separately.
Phase tracing is off, other existing transport and Windows diagnostics remain enabled. No scheduler wait or per-call DSP timing attribution.
Exact zero can include preset behavior or onset latency. Report transport missing frames separately. No subjective listening or battery energy measurement.

native.installed_panel_source_difference: Preserved pre-existing installed panel.rs, identified in source manifest; other source files matched candidate at build. All original source files restored afterward.

failed_startup.cause: Existing launcher only allowed original host basename; rejected candidate with exit64 before runtime/host launch. Private exact-candidate launcher was staged and pinned; original retained unchanged.

tests: Three quantum setup/split/delay tests passed with default and experimental native features.
Authenticated mixed-peer rejection passed with default and experimental maps.
Portable Windows header layout/negotiated-maximum checks passed with both compile definitions.
Existing returned-note-off and zero-frame expiry handling passed in experimental build.
Existing contained-terminal validation/no-new-work test passed in experimental build.
Counter drain test uses actual completed frames, ignores zero-frame call increments and refuses mismatched/missing readback.
assessment: No reliable performance improvement established. The 512-frame setting halves processing calls per frame, but measured Pigments process CPU did not materially improve and neither block size consistently delivered continuous audio. The two 256-frame conditions varied strongly. A sampled DVFS dip overlaps the 512-frame gap; the last 256-frame failure occurred at sampled full clock. Separate companion CPU was low during all repeated holds and higher during warm-ups. No sole cause is assigned.
